summary: Bound post-run verification and reject empty commands

delivery.outcome: Reject invalid post-run verification commands before execution, report not_run rather than success, and publish through protected validation and merge.
nonGoals: Configurable command deadline is deferred to a dependent ticket
No lifecycle persistence or IDE evidence-cache redesign

architecture.decision: Validate the entire command list before execution. Invalid configuration reports ok=false/action=not_run without lifecycle mutation. Preserve valid command ordering and injected runners.
architecture.rollback: Revert this runtime and regression-test change together.

commands: python -m pytest -q tests/test_post_run_verify_boundaries.py tests/test_post_run_verify.py tests/test_post_run_verify_env.py tests/test_loop.py
validation.evidence: Real bounded subprocess, invalid config, fail-fast ordering, stock/custom runner and environment regressions
